summary.title: SecureNova AI Identity Security Threat Model
summary.description: SecureNova Inc. operates an AI-powered customer service platform using an LLM-based AI agent integrated with Auth0 for human authentication and authorization. The AI agent communicates with internal REST APIs, retrieves knowledge through a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline, and invokes MCP server tools on behalf of authenticated users. The system includes human identities, non-human AI agent identities, OAuth 2.0 machine-to-machine clients, LLM API credentials, RAG service identities, and MCP server identities. This threat model evaluates identity-related attack surfaces, trust boundaries, credential security, privilege escalation, prompt injection, data poisoning, and auditability. Security controls are assessed using STRIDE, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, least privilege, Zero Trust principles, and MITRE ATLAS.

diagrams.title: SecureNova AI Identity System - DFD

data.name: Authentication Token Response
data.description: Auth0 returns an ID token and access token to the authenticated human user after successful authentication.

data.name: User Query + Access Token
data.description: Authenticated human user submits a customer service query and access token to the AI Agent.

data.name: LLM API Request
data.description: AI Agent sends prompts and completion requests over HTTPS to the external LLM provider. Treat prompts and responses as data crossing the SecureNova-to-provider trust boundary; do not send secrets or unnecessary customer data.

data.name: Knowledge Retrieval Request
data.description: The AI Agent sends a knowledge retrieval request to the RAG Pipeline to retrieve relevant information from the Vector Database or Knowledge Base based on the authenticated user's query.

data.name: Retrieved Knowledge Response
data.description: The RAG Pipeline returns relevant knowledge chunks and retrieved context from the Vector Database or Knowledge Base to the AI Agent for response generation.

data.name: Scoped M2M Access Token
data.description: Auth0 returns a short-lived, signed access token to the M2M Client. The token carries the configured API audience and least-privilege scopes and is validated by the receiving API.

data.name: Scoped MCP-to-API Request
data.description: MCP Server invokes an allowlisted Internal REST API using the scoped M2M access token. The API validates token signature, issuer, audience, expiry and required scope before authorizing the requested operation.

data.name: Customer Data Response
data.description: Customer Database returns the requested customer data to the Internal REST API over the protected internal service channel.

data.name: Secret Retrieval Request
data.description: AI Agent requests the LLM API credential from the restricted secret store through an authenticated workload identity; access is least-privilege and audited.

data.name: LLM API Credential
data.description: The secret store supplies the LLM API credential to the AI Agent through a protected channel. The credential is never placed in prompts, user-visible responses or logs.

data.name: Retrieved Knowledge Chunks
data.description: Vector Database / Knowledge Base returns the matching knowledge chunks and metadata to the RAG Pipeline.

data.name: Authentication Request
data.description: Human user submits authentication credentials or an authentication request to Auth0 over a secure connection.

threats.title: Authentication Request Tampering
threats.description: An attacker may modify authentication request parameters, including redirect URI, OAuth scopes or state values, to manipulate the authentication process and potentially gain unauthorised access to the SecureNova platform.
threats.mitigation: Enforce OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with PKCE (S256), validate redirect URIs against an allowlist, validate state and nonce parameters, enforce strict scope validation, and use secure HTTPS communication.

threats.title: Authentication Token Disclosure
threats.description: An attacker may obtain sensitive authentication information, such as authorization codes, access tokens or session credentials, through insecure transmission, exposed logs or improper token handling.
threats.mitigation: Enforce HTTPS/TLS, prevent tokens and credentials from being written to application logs, use short-lived access tokens, implement secure token storage, and validate token audience and scope.

threats.title: Auth0 Authentication Request Flooding
threats.description: An attacker may flood the Auth0 authentication endpoint with excessive login requests, exhausting available resources and preventing legitimate SecureNova customers from authenticating successfully.
threats.mitigation: Configure rate limiting, brute-force protection, suspicious IP detection, request throttling and monitoring of abnormal authentication request patterns.

data.name: Auth0
data.description: Auth0 authenticates human users using OIDC and issues identity and access tokens. It also provides OAuth 2.0 authorization services for machine-to-machine clients.

data.name: Human User
data.description: External human identity that accesses SecureNova's AI-powered customer service platform and authenticates through Auth0 using OpenID Connect (OIDC) and OAuth 2.0.

data.name: AI Agent
data.description: AI agent that processes authenticated user requests, interacts with the LLM API, retrieves knowledge through the RAG pipeline, and invokes MCP server tools on behalf of authenticated users.

data.name: LLM API
data.description: External large language model service that processes prompts and generates responses for the SecureNova AI Agent.

data.name: LLM API Key Store
data.description:
Secure storage for the LLM API credential used by the AI Agent to authenticate requests to the external LLM service.



Privilege Level: Restricted – AI service access only

data.name: RAG Pipeline (RAG Service Identity)
data.description: Retrieval-Augmented Generation service that retrieves relevant knowledge chunks from the knowledge base and returns contextual information to the AI Agent.

data.name: Vector Database / Knowledge Base
data.description: Stores indexed knowledge documents, embeddings, and retrieved text chunks used by the RAG Pipeline to provide context to the AI Agent.

data.name: MCP Server (Service Identity)
data.description: Model Context Protocol server that exposes controlled tools to the AI Agent and invokes authorized internal services on behalf of authenticated users.

data.name: Internal REST APIs
data.description: Internal business APIs invoked by the MCP Server to retrieve or modify customer and application data after authorization.

data.name: Vector Search Query
data.description: RAG Pipeline sends an embedding-based similarity search query to the Vector Database / Knowledge Base using its read-only service identity.

data.name: Customer Database
data.description: Stores customer profiles, account information, conversation history, and other sensitive customer data. Access is restricted to authorized internal REST APIs.

data.name: OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Token Request
data.description: The M2M Client authenticates to Auth0 using the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials grant and requests an access token for the configured API audience and least-privilege scopes.

data.name: Customer Data Query
data.description: Internal REST API sends an authorized customer-data query to the Customer Database over the protected internal service channel.

data.name: MCP Tool Invocation
data.description: AI Agent sends a tool invocation request to the MCP Server. The server validates the caller identity, tool allowlist and arguments before invoking an authorized internal API.

data.name: M2M Client (AI Agent Workload Identity)
data.description: OAuth 2.0 machine-to-machine client representing the non-human workload identity used by the SecureNova AI Agent/MCP integration. It authenticates to Auth0 using the client credentials grant, receives a scoped access token, and presents that token to authorized internal APIs. Client credentials must be held in a secrets manager and never embedded in prompts or logs.

data.name: M2M Access Token Presented to MCP Server
data.description: M2M Client presents its short-lived scoped access token to the MCP Server. The MCP Server validates issuer, signature, audience, expiry and required scopes before accepting tool requests.
